title: Impact door at close: sweep the closing feature's decisions, block on surviving citation hits
action: Per plan v2 kds-2 (D1b). build_impact_door in close.rs, stub-independent: (1) collect the closing feature's decision ids by reading .bee/decisions.jsonl for decide events whose feature field (kds-1) equals the closing feature — structured field ONLY, no time-window fallback (recorded deviation: pre-kds-1 decisions are kds-4/campaign debt). (2) For each id call sweep_decision_citations (render.rs:419), then EXCLUDE hits in docs/decisions/index.md, docs/history/<closing-feature>/, and the write-guard's generated-tree list (find its path list in hooks/write_guard and reuse, never hand-copy — if reuse is impossible name the deviation on the cap). (3) Any surviving hit => Door{blocking:true} with detail lines file:line + remedy: fix or annotate the citing doc and re-run close (the sweep re-runs fresh, a fixed doc clears itself). Recorded-deferral escape identical in shape to has_knowledge_freshness_deferral_decision (close.rs:687), tag impact-deferral. (4) Slot after the knowledge-freshness door: exit chain region close.rs:1403-1418 and all three doors vecs (close.rs:1182, 1232, 1301) plus the refusal branch listing. Tests (drivers/tests.rs): a doc outside exclusions citing a feature-stamped decision short8 refuses close naming file:line; fixing the doc clears on re-run; index.md and own-history citations never block; deferral decision demotes with reason quoted; a feature with no field-stamped decisions is clear; door absent nothing? no — door always present, detail clear when no hits.

truths: close refuses when an outside doc cites a closing-feature decision, naming file:line and the fix-and-rerun remedy
generated index, the feature's own history dir, and generated trees never block
no time-window collection exists — structured feature field only
recorded impact-deferral decision demotes the door with its reason in the detail

trace.inline_reason: sub-agent execution worker dispatched without a bee state worker add registration (Task-tool dispatch, no CLI hook to self-register); sibling kds-1 capped the same way

checks.evidence: packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/drivers/close.rs:896-948 build_impact_door pushes "<file>:<line> cites decision <short8>, touched by closing feature <feature> — remedy: fix or annotate the citing doc, then re-run bee close --feature <feature> (the sweep re-runs fresh)." and returns Door{door:impact, blocking:true}. Exit-chain refusal close.rs:1925-1943 emits "Impact debt for <feature> — close stops at the impact door: <detail>" plus remedy and next lines, exit code 1 (CLOSE_IMPACT_PREFIX close.rs:48-51). Tests drivers/tests.rs:2689-2705 assert blocking and detail contains docs/knowledge/areas/other/notes.md:1, remedy:, re-run bee close --feature demo; tests.rs:2706-2718 rewrites the doc and asserts detail==clear (re-derived fresh, no stub).

close.rs:908-913 skips hits via crate::verbs::decisions::touches_sweep_excluded(&file, Some(feature)) (kds-1 exclusion reused) then impact_sweep_in_generated_tree (close.rs:878-884) which iterates crate::hooks::write_guard::SCOUT_DIRS rather than a hand-copied list. Tests tests.rs:2719-2744: docs/decisions/index.md + docs/history/demo/CONTEXT.md -> detail==clear; docs/vendor/upstream.md -> detail==clear.

close.rs:840-851 feature_stamped_decision_ids filters active_decisions on type==decide && e.get("feature")==Some(feature) only; no date/since_ms term appears in the impact-door region (DecisionFilters is used only by has_impact_deferral_decision, with tag+feature). Tests tests.rs:2778 impact_door_never_walks_a_decision_with_no_structured_feature_field and tests.rs:2766 impact_door_is_clear_with_no_feature_stamped_decisions.

close.rs:859-871 has_impact_deferral_decision mirrors has_knowledge_freshness_deferral_decision with tag impact-deferral + feature and returns the deferring decision decision text; close.rs:925-935 returns Door{blocking:false, detail starting "deferred — ... a logged impact-deferral decision names <feature>: <reason>"}. Test tests.rs:2745-2765 asserts !door.blocking, detail.starts_with("deferred —"), and detail contains "defer the demo citation cleanup until the doc rewrite lands".
